intro: The gear that makes water days safer and easier, chosen around the guides on this site. Each link opens Amazon's current options, so you can compare prices, sizes and reviews.

groups.title: Safety essentials
groups.blurb: If you buy one thing, make it a well-fitted life jacket with a strong handle.

items.name: Dog life jacket with rescue handle
items.why: Bright, with flotation under the chest and chin and a sturdy handle for lifting your dog out of the water.

items.name: Floating long-line leash
items.why: Keeps control near water while your dog's recall is still a work in progress, and it won't sink.

items.name: Pet first aid kit
items.why: Gauze, wrap, saline and tick tools for cuts, stings and scrapes on the shore.

items.name: Rescue throw bag
items.why: Lets you reach a dog in trouble from shore or a boat without going in yourself.

groups.title: Beach day
groups.blurb: Shade, fresh water and a rinse at the end of the day.

items.name: Beach shade tent
items.why: Shade is the best protection against heatstroke on hot sand.

items.name: Collapsible travel bowl
items.why: So your dog drinks fresh water instead of sea or lake water.

items.name: Portable pet shower
items.why: Rinses salt and sand off before the car ride home.

items.name: Dog-safe sunscreen
items.why: For pink noses and thin coats. Human sunscreens with zinc oxide are toxic if licked.

items.name: Booties for hot sand
items.why: Protect pads from hot sand, shells and rocks.

groups.title: Boating and paddling
groups.blurb: Getting on and off safely, and staying comfortable aboard.

items.name: Floating boat ramp
items.why: Gives a tired dog an easy way to swim back aboard.

items.name: Dog boat ladder
items.why: A compact option with wide, non-slip steps.

items.name: Non-slip deck mat
items.why: A secure spot for your dog to settle while the boat is moving.
items.query: non slip boat deck mat dog

items.name: Paddleboard traction pad
items.why: Keeps paws from slipping on a kayak or SUP.

items.name: Portable grass potty pad
items.why: For long days on the water between shore stops.

groups.title: Pool
groups.blurb: A way out, and a warning if your dog goes in alone.

items.name: Dog pool ramp
items.why: An easy exit for dogs who can't manage the steps.

items.name: Pool alarm
items.why: Alerts you if something falls into the pool.

items.name: Foldable dog pool
items.why: Splash fun for small and flat-faced dogs who shouldn't swim deep.

groups.title: Water toys
groups.blurb: Bright, floating and easy to grip, to limit water gulping.

items.name: Floating bumpers
items.why: Classic retrieving toy that's easy to see and carry.

items.name: Floating water disc
items.why: Flat and light, so dogs swallow less water than with big balls.

items.name: Splash pad
items.why: Water fun without swimming, for hot days in the yard.

groups.title: After the swim
groups.blurb: Rinse, dry and protect ears, skin and paws.

items.name: Microfiber dog towel
items.why: Absorbs far more than a regular towel and dries fast.

items.name: Dog drying coat
items.why: A wearable towel for the car ride home, especially in cooler weather.

items.name: Drying ear cleaner
items.why: Ask your vet. Helps prevent ear infections in dogs who swim often.

items.name: Waterproof car seat cover
items.why: Keeps wet, sandy dogs off the seats.

items.name: Paw balm
items.why: Soothes pads dried out by salt, sand and ice melt.
